statement: research/published.json holds 40 cited rows, 7 of them added on 2026-09-26 with a source URL, the date read, the metric variant, the value exactly as printed and a quote under 15 words; 40 of 40 rows pass the row check and 12 of 12 deliberately broken copies of real rows are rejected by it. Of the four pairs the item named (GPT-4o and Claude Opus 5.5, each on GSM8K and HumanEval) 2 have a published row that bench/public.mjs publishedFor returns: GPT-4o gsm8k, GPT-4o humaneval. Claude Opus 5.5 gsm8k and Claude Opus 5.5 humaneval were not found published (the vendor announcement and system card were read and name neither benchmark), so no number was typed and the bar as written is not met. Both endpoints do have a row on ARC-AGI-1: GPT-4o 4.5 percent and Claude Opus 5.5 98.5 percent on the ARC Prize semi-private set, which is not the public evaluation set this tree runs. Pairs with no published row: Claude Opus 5.5 gsm8k, Claude Opus 5.5 humaneval, Claude Fable 5.1 gsm8k, Claude Fable 5.1 humaneval. No model was called and no set was re-run.
